title: task-types.json Is Keyed by Archetype, Not Task Type

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given nit:tasks' Archetype Proposal step, When it looks up a task's type in registry/task-types.json, Then an entry exists for each of backend, frontend, devops and qa, and each carries a defaultArchetype.

Given the registry, When its purpose is settled, Then it either describes task types with archetype defaults or is renamed to what it actually holds, and nit:init's template and the skills that read it agree.
Given a task of each type, When its default archetype is resolved, Then that archetype's implement step reaches the engineer that type implies, asserted by test.
